OWNER_ANSWER_THIS_CELL_IMPLEMENTS: Since the tove ran - it must be an animal (or at least something that has legs). Since it ran accross the road, I think of rabbits and deer which I've seen cross roads, and so I assume it's a smallish animal, most likely a mammel but it could also be a reptile.
